title: verify/types: ArticleVerification missing PartialEq
description: crates/verify/src/types.rs — ArticleVerification derives Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize but not PartialEq. Both SigType and VerifResult do derive PartialEq. Tests in verify/src/store.rs have to use matches! macro to test results rather than == because ArticleVerification lacks PartialEq. Adding PartialEq would make test assertions and production equality checks simpler and consistent with the inner types.
